node.title: DLI fixed-weight ambient-Q bridge
node.closure: finite additive Fourier positivity and exact layer normalization
node.statement: For the DLI primitive Haar events, every odd-band marginal and the terminal marginal is a sum of independent iid differences, so its additive Fourier transform is nonnegative. Therefore P(O_j)>=q^(-|U_j|), P(T_m)>=q^-1, and their product is at least q^-t. On the weight-w slice, if f_w is the primitive zero-fiber size, M_w=binom(n,w), and L_w is the realized image size of the t-moment map, then J_prim<=sum_w (M_w/2^n)(q^t/L_w)(f_w L_w/M_w). Primitive layers vanish for w<=t and w>=n-t. Hence a binomially weighted ambient-Q inflation at most 2^21 suffices for C2'', while image-normalized Q alone still owes the exact effective-image defect q^t/L_w.
node.attack_surface: Check the iid-difference representation of every Haar marginal, Fourier inversion over the formal codomain, the t-1 plus 1 exponent count, the fixed-weight image/ambient cancellation, the Vandermonde extreme-layer exclusion, and the distinction between asymptotic exp(o(n)) and the finite 21-bit payment.
node.falsifier: A Haar marginal with a negative Fourier coefficient under the stated odd-characteristic setup, failure of its zero mass to reach the reciprocal formal-codomain floor, or a mismatch in the exact layer identity for J_prim.
node.notes: This is an exact finite compiler from upstream-style fixed-density primitive Q to the local Haar target. It proves the denominator floor and isolates a sufficient weighted ambient-flatness numerator. It does not pay the 21-bit bound; dli_ambient_q_sqrt_route_no_go subsequently proves that its scale-free square-root strengthening is false, so the actual Haar denominator remains load-bearing.
